column1: # Domain aliases: surfaces that different bills use for the SAME referent.
# Mined from the corpus itself, not invented: eight competing bills legislate the
# same subject and each coins its own term, so the bills are a natural parallel
# vocabulary. The provenance column names the article that asserts the
# equivalence, so every row is checkable against the source.
# Deliberately small. Measured on a 45-query eval: 10 surfaces score nDCG@10
# 0.7455, 19 surfaces score 0.7431. More rows made it worse, because each extra
# variant costs a retrieval pass and dilutes the fusion. Add a row only with a
# measurement, and record what you rejected in excluded.tsv.
